method: The built-in browser pane at 375 x 812 (mobile emulation), the Next.js dev server on :3000 against the demonstration API on :8000, dark colour scheme, English; /admin signed in as the demonstration operator (hiring@apollo-care.example). BEFORE = main at the start of the sprint (web/src and web/e2e stashed, every changed file copied first and compared after the pop); AFTER = this branch. NOT the capture script and NOT the sweep (no Chromium on the machine). A control under 44 px is an a/button/select/input/textarea/summary narrower or shorter than 43.5 px, a checkbox or radio by its label; a sentence's inline link is exempt, as in the sweep and in WCAG 2.5.8. The /admin before-values are from the sprint's first measurement on main; the admin 'after' was taken before the later MessageForm, GrievanceForm and LegalPage edits, which do not touch /admin.
